Lina (PM): dropped a compact scorecard mock — header summary + row list + optional right rail for sample detail. PTAL for copy, keyboard flow, and a11y. https://figma.com/compact-scorecard Diego (Design): compact looks cleaner. Suggest header text: "Regressions: 8 (3 critical)" with an expand affordance. Chevron vs text link? Priya (Eng): chevron ok. note: avoid animating full list, use virtualized list and lazy render detail in right rail. canvas thumbnails for trends to reduce DOM cost. Ben (QA): current build bug: arrow nav breaks when right rail is open, skips cells. expected behavior: arrow moves rows, Enter opens detail, Esc closes. I'll document keymap. Ivy (Accessibility): add a "Skip to run summary" link at top, and make expand use aria-controls + aria-expanded. Use aria-live="polite" for totals and include textual delta like "+12% regressions" (don't rely on color). Lina (PM): microcopy tweak: bulk action label -> "Approve selections" when rows are selected. show disabled tooltip: "select at least one sample". Diego (Design): visual: delta pill with small chevron to expand breakdown. when collapsed show short text + percent. ensure 4.5:1 contrast and a pattern fill option for colorblind users. Priya (Eng): implementation snippet for live region:
Run totals: 8 regressions, 3 flaky samples
. We'll use canvas fallback and mount SVG on focus. Ben (QA): acceptance tests I'll add: arrow-only nav, Enter opens detail, Esc closes, cmd+shift+A quick-approve acts on selected rows, tooltips announced. Ivy (Accessibility): test NVDA/VoiceOver announcing sparkline alt text. propose offscreen label: "trend: stable with two dips in last 10 runs". Lina (PM): timeline: Priya prototype + Diego frames by EOD Wed, Ben/Ivy to draft tests. ux-bot: generate checklist. ux-bot: checklist created: [frames updated], [Keymap doc], [Canvas fallback PR], [A11y tests]. Diego (Design): will upload delta pill patterns and collapsed header before sync. Priya (Eng): estimate: 3 dev days virtual list + canvas; 1 QA day. I'll open a draft PR with example aria-live + keyboard handlers. Ben (QA): will include SR walkthroughs and keyboard-only flows in ticket. Ivy (Accessibility): will review tests and provide SR copy suggestions. Lina (PM): scheduling 20-min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. add outstanding issues to thread. :sparkles:
